name: tabs-vertical
title: Tabs vertical
description: Tabs stacked beside their panels, selected with Enter or Space.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/ui/tabs/tabs'; /** * Tabs stacked beside their panels. With manual activation, the arrow * keys only move focus; Enter or Space shows the focused tab's panel. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-tabs-vertical', imports: [Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger], template: `
Language, time zone and start page.
Email and push notifications.
Who can see your profile and activity.
`, }) export class TabsVerticalExample {}
